name: @merit/api
description: The /api/v1 surface API_CONTRACT specifies. Railway services: api (public origin) and api-admin (ADMIN_ORIGIN), one codebase deployed twice per ADR-083.
//: IT DECLARED NO RUNTIME DEPENDENCY UNTIL ADR-100 AND FASTIFY'S ABSENCE WAS THE FENCE RATHER THAN THE RULING. ADR-083 ruling 3 chose the framework and deliberately did not install it: the version lives in `pnpm-workspace.yaml`'s `catalog:` block, which session 144 did not hold, and `.npmrc`'s `save-exact` plus VG-12 make a version a human approves once rather than a caret. ADR-100 is that admission -- every package named, every resolution checked for a registry entry carrying a `sha512` integrity hash, `pnpm audit --audit-level=low` run and the closure delta stated -- and it is why `"fastify": "catalog:"` is below. THERE IS NO `build` SCRIPT AND THERE MUST NOT BE ONE. `CI-06/gate-inventory` probes every apps/*/package.json for that key and requires it ABSENT, because CI-07's row reads through an artifact that does not exist; a build script makes that gate fail on good news. Fastify 5 needs none, which ADR-083 section 5 measured and which `pnpm run start` now demonstrates rather than predicts: `node --experimental-strip-types src/index.ts` serves the registry with nothing compiled.
